sections.Profile:
The "Kick-Off" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on March 20, 1958, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Soccer, Sports, Original Theme, Football, Cheerleaders
